d6_d7_handling.D6_read: A5 04 D6 7F; reply reassembled from A4/D6 fragments at offset (idx-1)*15; 144-byte image = 9x15 + 9 last fragment
d6_d7_handling.D7_write: A4 fragments, 15-byte chunk (hard-coded `mov x, #0xf` / `add x25,x25,#0xf` in writeDeviceConfig @0x79e63c), 1-based index, A4 length byte = chunk+5, ack A5 05 D7 00 81
d6_d7_handling.fragment_chunk_evidence: PROVEN STATIC - 15 is hard-coded; 2.23 has no subpackageLength() symbol (grep over asm/moojiang returns 0)
